source:
Let me explain how the POKéMON

two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.

around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go

Communication System.$

请让我为您介绍宝可梦无线俱乐部的

厅”。\p您可以与周围同样进入了联谊厅的训
练家进行连接。\p您可以与他们一起聊天、进行对战或

角”。\p您可以在这个房间里与朋友交换宝可
梦或进行对战。\p有时，您可能无法在联谊厅或直接角
找到您的朋友。\p遇到这种情况时，请尽量靠近您的朋
友。\p如果没有连接无线适配器，您仍然可

translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！我是杰克！\p我一直等着你呢。来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General1
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pKeeping your POKéMON
happy?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is healthy.
It eats a lot every day.$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！我是贝\n弗莉！\p你的宝可梦每天都开开心心的吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}可健康\n了，每天都吃得特别多呢。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General2
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BEVERLY!\pI fancied up my\n{STR_VAR_3} and made it\leven cuter than before!$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！我是贝\n弗莉！\p我给我的{STR_VAR_3}精\n心打扮了一番，现在它比以前还要可\l爱了呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pAre your POKéMON in prime
form?\pLet's chat about POKéMON
again.$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！我是贝\n弗莉！\p你的宝可梦都保持在最佳状态吗？\p下次再一起聊聊宝可梦的话题吧。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_FoundItem
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pMy husband got some
NUGGETS.\pIf you'd like, you could
have one as thanks for\lhelping me out.\pI'll be at NATIONAL PARK.
Please come see me when\lyou can.$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！我是贝
弗莉！\p我先生弄到了一些金珠。\p如果你想要的话，可以拿一颗，当作
平时陪我解闷的谢礼。\p我就在自然公园。有空的时候请顺便
过来看看我呀。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_Battle
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BEVERLY!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！我是贝\n弗莉！\p我一直在等着你呢。来对战吧！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTeach
source: What am I doing?\pI'm shaking trees using HEADBUTT.\pDo you think your POKéMON will\nwant to HEADBUTT, too?\pI can teach one the move HEADBUTT\nif you'd like. It's fun!$
translation: 问我在干什么？\p我正在用头锤撞树呢。\p你觉得你的宝可梦也想试试头锤吗？\p如果你愿意的话，我可以把“头锤”\n传授给它。可好玩了！$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
source: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$
translation: 看起来你已经步入正轨了！\p我已经把秘传学习器“闪光”交给助\n手了。一定要记得去拿哦！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
source: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$
translation: 很好，看得出你非常努力！\p我已经把“探宝器”交给了助手。一\n定要记得去领哦！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
source: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$
translation: 你的图鉴收集得相当顺利嘛！\p我已经把“护符金币”交给了助手。\n一定要记得去拿！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60

translation: 啊，你终于突破50种了！\p我已经把“学习装置”交给了助手。\n一定要记得去领哦！$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pLILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out
sale has finally arrived!\pAll the thingamajigs and doodads that
you've always dreamt about…\pYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！现在是“宝可梦新闻”时
间。\p这是大家翘首以盼的大新闻！\p水静百货大楼的清仓大特卖终于开售
啦！\p那些你一直梦寐以求的稀奇玩意儿
......\p说不定就能在这里与它们命中注定般
相遇哦！\p以上就是本期“宝可梦新闻”的全部
内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER will be
appearing in LILYCOVE CITY with just\la mere {STR_VAR_1}-day wait to go!\pThe BLEND MASTER is said to be
the best in all HOENN when it comes to\lspinning a BERRY BLENDER.\pThose people who want to make great
{POKEBLOCK}S or see the MASTER in action\lare urged to save their BERRIES.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！现在是“宝可梦新闻”时
间。\p我们为所有制作
{POKEBLOCK}的训练家带\l来了重磅好消息！\p传说中的混合达人，还有短短
{STR_VAR_1}天就要在水\l静市现身啦！\p据说在摇转树果混合器这方面，混合
达人的技术在整个丰缘都是首屈一指\l的。\p想要做出顶级
{POKEBLOCK}，或是想要\l一睹大师风采的人，赶快把树果存好\l吧！\p以上就是本期“宝可梦新闻”的全部
内容。$

source:

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER has
finally appeared!\pThe BLEND MASTER is spinning

translation:
大家好！现在是“宝可梦新闻”时

会场摇转树果混合器呢。\p想要做出顶级

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_TryPokemonPrinter
source: It's a POKéMON PRINTER!\pIt can put a print of your POKéMON\non the back of your TRAINER CARD.\pIt costs only ¥50.\nWould you like to try it?$
translation: 这是宝可梦打印机！\p它可以把你的宝可梦印在训练家卡片\n的背面。\p只需要¥50。要试一试吗？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_BigSmileForPhoto
source: A big smile for the photo, please!\nThree… Two… One…\pFlash!$
translation: 拍照时请露出灿烂的笑容！三..\n....二......一...\l...\p咔嚓！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_PrintIsReadyCheckTrainerCard
source: Your POKéMON print is ready!\nCheck your TRAINER CARD.$
translation: 宝可梦照片已经打印好啦！去确认一\n下你的训练家卡片吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WishICouldShowOffStickers
source: Giggle…\nI collected a ton of STICKERS.\lI wish I could show them off…$
translation: 嘻嘻......我收集了好多贴纸\n呢。真想好好炫耀一下......$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_GiveYouStickerIfYouBrag
source:
Oh, excellent!
You've come to the right place!\pLook, look! See? See?
These are my STICKERS!\lLook how many I got!\pI bet you want some.
I bet you do!\pI'll give a STICKER if you can tell
me something awesome about\lyourself.\pWhat will you brag about?$
translation:
哇，太棒了！你可找对人啦！\p看呀看呀！看到了吗看到了吗？这些
都是我的贴纸！看我收集了多少！\p你肯定也很想要吧？绝对想要对不
对！\p只要你跟我吹嘘一下你身上有什么了
不起的事情，我就送你一张贴纸。\p你要跟我吹嘘什么呢？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutSomethingForMe
source: Brag about something for me.\nI'll give you a STICKER.$
translation: 跟我吹嘘吹嘘你的事吧。我就送你一\n张贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutWhatToday
source: Oh, hi!\nHere comes the braggart.\pWhat are you going to brag about\ntoday?$
translation: 哎呀，你好！吹牛大王来啦。\p你今天打算吹嘘些什么呢？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLowest
source: Oh, wow, you made it into the\nHALL OF FAME.\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇哦，你成功登上殿堂了啊。\p挺厉害的嘛，嗯！这个就送你一张\n吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLow
source: Oh, wow, you've entered the\nHALL OF FAME often!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇哦，你经常登上殿堂呢！\p真让人佩服，嗯！这个就送你一张\n吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHigh
source: Whoa! You've made it into the\nHALL OF FAME that often?\lThat's seriously incredible, yup!\pYou own the POKéMON LEAGUE!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇塞！你登上殿堂这么多次啦？这真\n的太厉害了，嗯！\p宝可梦联盟都快成你家开的了！这个\n就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHighest
source: No way! You've gone into the\nHALL OF FAME that many times?\pYou're beyond incredible, yup!\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$
translation: 不会吧！你登上殿堂这么多次？！\p简直厉害到没边了，嗯！服了你了，\n这个必须送给你。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_HoFStickerApplied
source: The HALL OF FAME STICKER was\napplied to the TRAINER CARD.$
translation: 在训练家卡片上贴上了殿堂贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendHoF
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$
translation: 哎呀，不行不行了。\p你简直就是活着的传奇啊。我已经没\n有贴纸可以给你了。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLowest
source: Oh, wow, there are POKéMON EGGS?\nI didn't know that!\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇哦，原来还有宝可梦蛋这种东西？\n我以前都不知道呢！\p挺不错的嘛，嗯！这个就送你一张\n吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLow
source: You've hatched that many EGGS?\nYou really must like them!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 你孵化了那么多蛋啊？你肯定特别喜\n欢蛋吧！\p真让人佩服，嗯！这个就送你一张\n吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHigh
source: Whoa! You've hatched a whole\nbunch of EGGS!\pYou're an EGG-hatching machine!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇塞！你孵了超级多的蛋啊！\p你简直就是一台孵蛋机！这个就送你\n一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHighest
source: Wh… You hatched that many EGGS?\pWhat's behind your love of EGGS?\nIt's beyond incredible, yup!\pYou're too awesome, I tell you.\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$
translation: 什......你孵了那么多蛋？！\p你对蛋的爱到底是怎么回事啊？简直\n厉害到没边了，嗯！\p你实在太了不起了，真的。服了你\n了，这个必须送给你。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_EggStickerApplied
source: The EGG STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$
translation: 在训练家卡片上贴上了蛋贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendEggs
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$
translation: 哎呀，不行不行了。\p你简直就是活着的传奇啊。我已经没\n有贴纸可以给你了。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLowest
source: Oh, wow, you've had success\nlink battling?\pYou're pretty strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇，你在通信对战中屡屡获胜是吧？\p确实相当厉害呢！这个送给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLow
source: You've beaten your friends a lot\nlink battling, huh?\pYou're impressively strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 你在通信对战中赢过朋友很多次吧？\p实力真令人佩服呢！这个送给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHigh
source: Whoa! You've beaten your friends\na frightful number of times.\pHave you lost friends over this?\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation: 哇！你打败朋友的次数多得吓人啊。\p可别因此连朋友都做不成哦？这个送\n给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHighest
source:
Wh… Wickedly whoa!
You've won mind-blowingly often!\pIt just knocks me out thinking
about how tough you are.\pYou're the stuff of nightmares!
That's it, I have to give you this.$
translation:
哇、哇塞！太可怕了！你获胜的次数
多得难以置信！\p光是想象你到底有多强，我就觉得喘
不过气了。\p你简直就是对手的噩梦！好，这个非
给你不可了。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_VictoryStickerApplied
source: The VICTORY STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$
translation: 在训练家卡片上贴上了胜利贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendLinkWins
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$
translation: 哎呀，不行不行了。\p你简直就是活着的传奇啊。我已经没\n有贴纸可以给你了。$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
source: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$
translation: 我还远远没有把宝可梦的魅力全部展\n现出来呢。\p以后可要请你经常来当我最忠实的观\n众哦！$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
source:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$
translation: 三十年来，我一直在探寻古代遗迹！\p不，等等，我已经找了四十年了吗？\p嗯......甚至可能是五十年\n......我到底从事这个多久\l了？$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
source: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$
translation: 从你的培育方式中能学到很多。\p如果不介意的话，在下希望能与你再\n战一场。$

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
source: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…$
translation: 我真不该犯糊涂一边跑步一边对战\n的！\p我得去跑两步冷静一下......$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
source: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.$
translation: 宝可梦似乎会根据各自的性格，喜好\n不同种类的\l{POKEBLOCK}。$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
source: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!$
translation: 是谁拥有野外生存的知识与技巧？\p正是我们宝可梦巡护员！$

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
source: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$
translation: 送神火山......宝可梦灵魂长\n眠之地......\p这里一定洋溢着安抚灵魂的力量吧\n......$

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
source:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$
translation: 哈啊......哈啊......\n累死我了......\p来的时候容易，回去可就难了。\p我还有力气踏上返程的路吗？$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
source: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$
translation: 那边的那个年轻人长得真像我丈夫年\n轻的时候啊。\p看得我都害羞了！$

label: VSSeeker_Text_BatteryNotChargedNeedXSteps
source: The battery isn't charged enough.\pNo. of steps required to fully\ncharge the battery: {STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation: 电池电量不足。\p要充满电量还需走的步数：\n{STR_VAR_1}\l{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_NoTrainersWithinRange
source: There are no Trainers within range\nwho can battle…\pThe VS Seeker was turned off.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation: 范围内没有可以对战的训练家..\n....\p对战搜寻镜已关闭。\n{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_TrainersNotReady
source: The other Trainers don't appear\nto be ready for battle.\pLet's wait till later.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation: 其他训练家看起来还没有做好对战的\n准备。\p过段时间再试吧。\n{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$
translation: 喂！我在常青森林见过你！$

label: Route3_Text_BenRematchIntro
source: Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!$
translation: 嗨！我喜欢短裤！穿着既舒服又方便\n活动！\p你也应该穿短裤才对！$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceRematchIntro
source: Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?$
translation: 打扰一下！你一直盯着我看，对不\n对？$

label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
source: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!$
translation: 你也是训练家吧？那就马上来过过招\n吧！$

label: Route3_Text_SallyRematchIntro
source: That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!$
translation: 你看我的那种眼神......真是\n让我太感兴趣了！$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
source: Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!$
translation: 喂！你怎么回事啊？你竟然还是没有\n穿短裤！$

label: Route3_Text_JamesRematchIntro
source: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.$
translation: 我要用我刚开始培育的宝可梦来和你\n对战！$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyRematchIntro
source: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored again, eh!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！太棒了！我正闲得发慌\n呢！$

label: Route9_Text_BriceRematchIntro
source: Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!$
